name: Rough Puff Pastry
summary: Butter chunks worked in cold. Faster than classic puff.

steps.text: Rub cold butter into the flour, leaving large visible pieces.
Add water and bring together roughly. Do not smooth it.
Give four book folds with 30 minute chills between each.
Rest fully chilled before rolling out.

bake.notes: Bake hot from cold or the butter melts before it steams.

notes: Visible butter streaks in the dough are correct, not a mistake.
